## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Mar 6, 2026 - Jul 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _AndyH813_, Jul 1, 2026, 1/5: "I downloaded this app and tried the free trial. The app crashes every time I try to open it. Customer support was no help when I contacted them. And then I was charged for a subscription even though it was not showing up in my settings as an active subscription. Save yourself the hassle and skip this one."
            2. _$igvard_, May 21, 2026, 1/5: "I have been an avid Endel subscriber for quite some time now and have always enjoyed and benefitted from the soundscapes. Up until the last version Endel has been my trusty companion when working on complex tasks - never further away than a simple click on its icon in the Mac menu bar. Now - the rich menu bar has been replaced with a generic menu with 2 options: ”Play” and ”Pause”. And to top it off, neither Play nor Pause works, which forces the user to find the app’s bug-ridden main window (wherever that decided to go hide - it’s quite random…) Long story short: I can’t deal with rubbish such as this. Life is too short. 3 months ago Endel was king, now there are significantly better options out there. Don’t waste your time and money on Endel, have a look at Brain.fm, Noisli or Dark Noise."
            3. _FluxtheMaster_, Jun 21, 2026, 2/5: "Update: issues continues. App is not Usable unless my phone is turn on all the time. If something taps my phone, if I get a call or text the music turns off. This is not how the app used to work. But for me to be able to meditate is impossible now. Waste of money to me now. Wrote a review talking about the issues with it turning off when getting off the app. It seems they have fixed the issue with an update or perhaps my phone was updating the app and that’s why it stopped working. For whatever reason it stopped working it’s now working exactly has it should and better than ever. They update the types of sounds you can have often of which the newest one is nature and it’s amazing to listen too. This app has pretty much replaced the other apps in my meditation cycles and allowed me to mediate in peace without words or direction. Allows me and my mind to just sync up and calm down. Definitely recommend"
